attackers_goals: Use an account that was possibly compromised to gain access to the network.
description: A user attempted to connect from an unusual country that no one from this organization has connected from before. This may indicate the account was compromised.
investigative_actions: See whether the service authentication was successful. Confirm that the activity is benign (e.g. the user has switched locations and providers). Verify if the country is an approved country to connect from. Follow further actions done by the user.
name: First VPN access attempt from a country in organization

variations.name: First successful VPN access from a country in organization
variations.description: A user successfully connected from an unusual country that no one from this organization has connected from before. This may indicate the account was compromised.
variations.attackers_goals: Use an account that was possibly compromised to gain access to the network.
variations.investigative_actions: See whether the service authentication was successful. Confirm that the activity is benign (e.g. the user has switched locations and providers). Verify if the country is an approved country to connect from. Follow further actions done by the user.
